group_note: Six biology items, each a single question with four short text options and no printed statement block, list, table or figure, so the grouping on `structure: plain` holds for every member. Two members differ on the demand axis and both differences are made by the same test: does the stem ask which fact, ask why, or ask that a fact be turned onto a stated case? q097 asks "because it", so the live decision is whether a stated effect accounts for the practice, and it alone is `explanatory_reasoning`. q101 supplies a case ("If you suspect major deficiency of antibodies in a person") and asks where to look, so the stored identity of antibodies has to be applied rather than merely retrieved, and it alone is `application`. The remaining four are `recall`: one stored expansion, genus, structure or stage names the option. Solution structure is `single_step` throughout, and that is a deliberate uniform call rather than an unexamined one - none of the six carries a negated task over a memorised list and none requires a separate verdict per option, which is the test that produced `several_independent_checks` in this subject's other packets. Elimination was recorded in three members and withheld in three, on one rule: the fact cited must be cheaper than the answer and must strike out named options. It holds for q097 (the three inbreeding purposes strike options 1, 2 and 3), q099 (the Myxine stem in a name marks a hagfish, striking options 3 and 4) and q100 (holdfast and rhizoid are not bacterial structures, striking options 1 and 2). It is withheld from q098 for a reason worth recording: all four options expand G-I-F-T element by element, so the acronym narrows nothing. On the trap axis the group divides cleanly by what kind of neighbour each wrong option carries, following the rulebook's tie-breaks. `other_one_fact` is used where the option names a different member of the same family - three hagfish genera against the lamprey (q099), mesosomes against fimbriae (q100), albumin and fibrinogen against globulin (q101). `neighbouring_fact` is used where the families themselves differ - the algal holdfast and the bryophyte rhizoid (q100), invertebrate haemocytes (q101). `wrong_site_or_stage` carries q102 entirely, because its four options are one timeline and each wrong one is the real stage of a different milestone. `neighbouring_question_answer` carries q097 entirely, because all three wrong options are the published purposes of inbreeding, the complementary practice. q098 is the only member whose devices are verbal rather than factual, and it is the only one with `single_word_substitution` (option 2 swaps one word of four) and `look_alike_term` (options 1 and 4 keep the shape and initials and exchange elements). This is the one packet in which every wrong option carries a nameable device - all eighteen are tagged - and that follows from the option sets being built out of the same family as the key in every member, not from a looser standard being applied here. No trap sits on an official answer, no source damage verdict was needed (q101's "Fibrinogin" is a recoverable misspelling, recorded in its note), and no `new_*` escape was used.
